title: Say a strategy. Get a Backtest.
author: Extreme_Leg_6162
selftext: No yapping just facts: A backtest station that takes natural language and compiles the strategy to the backtest engine's vocabulary and sends back a interpretation and clarity request(if your strategy is vague), once you've reviewed the compiled strategy, you can run the backtest on any valid CSV financial dataset with the traditional OHLCV format. What strategy would you backtest?
